description: Update an organization custom field by field_code. field_type and field_code cannot be changed.

field_code.description: The field_code (40-char hash for custom fields) from the field create/list response. NOT the human field name.

important_fields.description: Important-field highlighting: enabled, stage_ids (always references DEAL stages, even on person/org fields).

required_fields.description: Required-field config: enabled (person/org fields support only this flag).

ui_visibility.description: UI visibility: add_visible_flag, details_visible_flag, show_in_add_deal_dialog{show, order}, show_in_add_person_dialog{show, order}.

name: pipedrive_update_organization_field
